Evaluating whether to bid on St. James Place.

The bid is $223, $43 above list price. The next minimum bid would be $224. My prior ceiling estimate was roughly $230–$240. I will drop out if the price exceeds that.

The $224 bid is still under the $230–$240 ceiling. This is a bidding war; p3 seems committed to winning St. James Place. Oranges offer the highest ROI, and the property is valuable as a trade chip.

Dropping out would leave p3 with $1,277 cash after paying $223 for St. James Place. I could bid one more dollar to push the price higher or secure the property.

Letting p3 win St. James Place at a high price would preserve cash for the light blue set. Oriental and Connecticut are unowned, while Vermont is already owned.

Paying $224 would leave $1,182 cash. That is enough to buy Oriental and Connecticut later. The lone orange offers little rent without a monopoly, but its trade value remains high.
